words.word: and he as a rotten thing

occurrences.text: And he, as a rotten thing, consumeth, as a garment that is moth eaten.
words: And he as a rotten thing

occurrences.text: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.
A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.

When I heard, my belly trembled; my lips quivered at the voice: rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in myself, that I might rest in the day of trouble: when he cometh up unto the people, he will invade them with his troops.
